I wrote `component.html` in the folder, but I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It's the full screen at 1280px inside `#component`, in static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript. It follows `DESIGN.md`:
- **Page:** white paper, one column up to 1120px wide with 48px above and 32px at the sides. The heading "Notifications" is on the left in Unbounded Light caps, and the "Mark All as Read" button is on the right as the one primary 44px ink pill.
- **List:** the six notifications sit in one card with 52px rows and 1px dividers. The first three are unread, shown with a bold message, an accent dot and an "Unread" pill, so unread doesn't rely on colour alone. The times are muted.
- **Styling:** everything uses design tokens, with no raw hex values or custom font sizes.

I copied only the light-theme tokens this screen uses into the file's `<style>` block, so it is self-contained. The dusk theme isn't included. The Unbounded and Archivo fonts aren't in the folder, so the file falls back to the system fonts in the token stacks.
